title: Mount Kailash as an energy vortex where fingernails grow faster

tellings.quote: Mount Kyash is an example. I think Sod Guru went and said that his fingernails grew faster on the mountain

plain: Mount Kailash, a sacred mountain, is described as a kind of energy vortex, a place where the body itself seems to change: the spiritual teacher Michels calls Sod Guru reportedly said his fingernails grew faster while he was on the mountain. Michels repeats this himself, as something Sod Guru said, offering it as an example of a place with unusual power.
